rules: The subject is the deprecated API or library the detector message names; confirm from the reviewed source that it is imported and used there before treating the finding as confirmed.
Take the replacement from the official deprecation notice or migration guide for the named API, not from the detector message alone, and cite it.
Check the replacement against the module's minSdk, desugaring and existing dependencies; a replacement that needs a new library must declare it in the build file supplied as exact source.
Preserve observable behaviour: threading, lifecycle and callback order of the replaced API must be matched or the change must be review-only.
A migration that needs configuration outside the repository (a server project, credentials, a service account) cannot be completed client-side; record it as a publication blocker.
